test_description: Verify that a signed message cannot be executed more than once on the destination chain
expected_result: Message rejected on second execution
notes: Test with same nonce, signature, and payload

test_description: Attempt to execute a bridge message with an invalid or tampered signature
expected_result: Message rejected with invalid signature error
notes: Test with modified payload, wrong signer, and expired timestamps

test_description: Submit a state proof that does not correspond to any valid block on the source chain
expected_result: Proof verification fails and transaction reverts
notes: Test with random bytes, valid-format but invalid content, and replayed proofs

test_description: Submit two bridge transactions with the same nonce but different payloads
expected_result: Second transaction rejected due to nonce collision
notes: Test across different validators and relayers

test_description: Execute a bridge message intended for chain A on chain B by manipulating chain ID field
expected_result: Transaction rejected due to chain ID mismatch
notes: Test with swapped chain IDs, missing chain ID, and zero chain ID

test_description: Submit a proof that passes some verification steps but fails others (e.g.
expected_result: valid Merkle root but invalid path)
actual_result: All verification steps must pass before execution
notes: PENDING
reporter: Test edge cases where partial verification might succeed

test_description: Attempt to submit a state root from an address not registered as a sequencer
expected_result: Submission rejected with unauthorized error
notes: Test with random addresses, revoked sequencers, and expired registrations

test_description: Submit a previously accepted state root with a new batch of transactions
expected_result: State rejected due to duplicate or outdated root
notes: Test with old state roots and reordered transactions

test_description: Submit a state root that does not correctly apply the included transactions
expected_result: State transition verification fails
notes: Test with incorrect account balances, wrong nonces, and invalid state diffs

test_description: Attempt to vote with more tokens than the account holds or with delegated tokens not owned
expected_result: Vote weight capped at actual balance
notes: Test with flash loans, multiple delegations, and cross-chain voting

test_description: Take a snapshot at a manipulated block height or with artificially inflated balances
expected_result: Snapshot reflects on-chain state at specified block
notes: Test with reorgs, malicious validators, and late block submissions

test_description: Replay a previously executed proposal on a different chain or after the voting period
expected_result: Proposal rejected due to invalid timestamps or chain context
notes: Test with expired proposals and cross-chain replay

test_description: Submit votes or execute proposals at unexpected times (before voting starts
expected_result: after deadline)
actual_result: Actions rejected outside allowed time window
notes: PENDING
reporter: Test with block timestamp manipulation and race conditions

test_description: Execute a proposal without meeting the minimum quorum requirement
expected_result: Execution blocked until quorum is met
notes: Test with low participation, delegated votes, and abstain votes

test_description: Claim rewards multiple times for the same staking period or with inflated reward rates
expected_result: Duplicate claims rejected; rewards capped at earned amount
notes: Test with reentrancy, multiple claim calls, and reward rate manipulation

test_description: Exploit integer division or rounding errors to accumulate small amounts over many transactions
expected_result: Rewards calculated with correct precision and no dust accumulation
notes: Test with minimum amounts, maximum precision, and many small claims

test_description: Claim rewards and immediately restake to earn rewards on rewards in the same period
expected_result: Compounding limited to allowed intervals or epochs
notes: Test with rapid restaking and flash loans

test_description: Create a DID or pass KYC with forged or stolen identity documents
expected_result: Identity verification fails with invalid document error
notes: Test with modified documents, stolen credentials, and synthetic identities

test_description: Reuse a verified identity from one chain or application on another without re-verification
expected_result: Identity must be re-verified or cross-chain verified
notes: Test with cross-chain identity reuse and expired verifications

test_description: Delegate identity verification to an untrusted third party or use a revoked verifier
expected_result: Only trusted verifiers can attest to identities
notes: Test with revoked verifiers, malicious verifiers, and delegation chains

test_description: Submit two different blocks at the same height from the same validator
expected_result: Double signing detected and validator slashed
notes: Test with equivocation, network partitions, and delayed blocks

test_description: Withhold block proposals or votes to halt the chain
expected_result: Chain continues with other validators after timeout
notes: Test with single validator failure, cascading failures, and network delays

test_description: Selectively exclude transactions from blocks to manipulate outcomes
expected_result: All valid transactions included within reasonable time
notes: Test with frontrunning, sandwich attacks, and transaction ordering manipulation

test_description: Delegate or undelegate stake at critical times to influence validator set or voting power
expected_result: Stake changes subject to unbonding period and cannot affect current epoch
notes: Test with rapid stake changes, flash loans, and epoch boundaries

test_description: Call mint function from an address without minter role or with invalid parameters
expected_result: Minting rejected with unauthorized error
notes: Test with random addresses, revoked minters, and expired permissions

test_description: Mint tokens beyond the maximum supply cap or cause total supply to overflow
expected_result: Transaction reverts due to supply cap or overflow protection
notes: Test with maximum values, edge cases, and concurrent minting

test_description: Exploit race condition between mint and burn operations to create tokens out of thin air
expected_result: Atomic operations prevent race conditions
notes: Test with concurrent mint/burn calls and reentrancy

test_description: Set extremely high or low gas prices to manipulate transaction ordering or block rewards
expected_result: Gas prices bounded by protocol parameters
notes: Test with zero gas, maximum gas, and negative gas prices

test_description: Claim gas refunds multiple times or for transactions that were not executed
expected_result: Refunds limited to actual unused gas and cannot be claimed twice
notes: Test with reentrancy, failed transactions, and partial execution

test_description: Use inaccurate gas estimation to cause transactions to fail or consume excessive gas
expected_result: Gas estimation accurate within protocol tolerance
notes: Test with complex contracts, state-dependent gas costs, and edge cases
